description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class named LogFragment used for displaying log data within an Android application. It creates and manages a LogView embedded inside a ScrollView, configures visual styles and padding, and responds to text changes to automatically scroll to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that provides a user interface component for displaying logs inside a scrollable view, designed for debugging and log monitoring within an app.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, applying styling and layout parameters, and returns the root view containing the log display.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's onCreateView to inflate the views, set up a text change listener for auto-scrolling, and return the view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the embedded LogView instance.
